name: Sentinel
summary: Sentinel is a mech sim made in two weeks for Mechjam 3, featuring wave based attack/defense gameplay on a large map. Your mission is to navigate to the given waypoints, defeat any encountered resistance, and then defend the location until new coordinates are given. Remember to pay attention to your heat, and check your radar frequently to track waypoints/enemies. Points are picked at random, and waves get harder as time goes on - survive as long as you can.
